description:
Send command imports a file as a blob and announces it on the specified
 topic
steps: Run send with --topic mytopic and a test file

Verify file is imported into blob store (hash
 printed)
Verify announcement is published via gossip on the topic

description:
Receive command listens on a topic and downloads announced
 blobs
steps: Start receiver with --topic mytopic
Have sender announce a file on the same topic

Verify receiver
  gets the gossip announcement
Verify receiver downloads the blob by hash

Verify file is written to the output
 directory with correct content

description:
Topic is user-specified via --topic flag and determines gossip
 channel
steps: Start sender with --topic alpha and a file
Start receiver with --topic alpha

Verify receiver
 gets the file
Start another receiver with --topic beta

Verify beta receiver does NOT get the
 file

description: Sender prints its node ID for sharing with remote receivers
steps:
Run
 send command
Verify node ID (public key hex) is printed to stdout/logs

Verify the printed ID can be used as --peer
  argument

description:
Receiver connects to sender via --peer flag using relay
 transport
steps: Start two nodes on same machine with relay URL configured

Disable mDNS on both nodes (passive
 mode) to force relay usage
Sender imports file and announces on topic

Receiver uses --peer with sender node ID and
  same topic
Verify relay-based discovery and connection

Verify file is transferred successfully via
 relay

description:
Receiver discovers sender via mDNS on same network without
 --peer
steps: Start two nodes on same machine with mDNS active mode

Sender announces file on --topic
 test
Receiver subscribes to --topic test without --peer flag

Verify mDNS discovery finds the sender on
 loopback
Verify file transfer completes via mDNS discovery
Start receiver with default output dir
Receive a file

Verify file appears in
 ./received/
Repeat with --output-dir /tmp/custom
Verify file appears in /tmp/custom/

description: Original filename is preserved in the received file
steps:
Send a file
 named test.pdf (doesnt need to be an actual pdf if you don't have one)
Receive the file
Verify the output file is named test.pdf

description: Multiple files can be sent on the same topic
steps:
Start receiver process
  on topic multi on same machine
Start sender and send file1.txt on topic multi

Start another sender and send
 file2.txt on topic multi
Verify both files appear in receiver output directory

description: Graceful shutdown on Ctrl+C for both sender and receiver
steps:
Start
 sender
Press Ctrl+C
Verify process exits cleanly without errors
Repeat for receiver

description: Application builds and runs as a workspace member
steps:
Run cargo build
 -p p2panda-file-sharing
Verify build succeeds with no errors

Run cargo run -p p2panda-file-sharing --
 --help
Verify CLI help is displayed

description:
Integration test: two in-process nodes transfer a file via
 mDNS
steps: Spawn two TestNodes with mDNS active on same machine

Node A imports file as blob and gossips
 announcement on topic
Node B subscribes to same gossip topic

Node B receives announcement and downloads blob by
 hash
Verify downloaded content matches original file

description:
Integration test: two in-process nodes transfer a file via relay (no
 mDNS)
steps: Spawn two TestNodes with mDNS passive and relay URL configured

Node B adds Node A as bootstrap peer
  with relay endpoint address
Node A imports file as blob and gossips announcement on topic

Node B subscribes to
 same gossip topic
Node B receives announcement and downloads blob by hash

Verify downloaded content matches
 original file

description:
Integration test: topic isolation prevents cross-topic file
 leakage
steps: Spawn three TestNodes on same machine
Node A gossips file announcement on topic alpha

Node B
 subscribes to topic alpha and receives the announcement

Node C subscribes to topic beta and does NOT receive the
 announcement
Verify Node B gets the file and Node C does not
